headline: Los Angeles rapper ColdheartedAC, real name Ada William Obayuwana, 31, has been arrested after being named in a 25-count federal indictment over an alleged $8.1 MILLION check-cashing scheme.
body: Los Angeles rapper ColdheartedAC, real name Ada William Obayuwana, 31, has been arrested after being named in a 25-count federal indictment over an alleged $8.1 MILLION check-cashing scheme. Federal prosecutors allege ColdheartedAC and two others were involved in obtaining stolen and fraudulent checks and using fake identities and bank accounts to cash them. Authorities say that in December 2023, ColdheartedAC allegedly had more than 100 stolen or fraudulent checks inside his car in Oceanside with a combined face value of over $6.1 MILLION. Among them were 48 stolen U.S. Treasury checks worth approximately $2.56 million, including checks tied to tax refunds, veterans’ benefits and Social Security payments. Prosecutors allege eight checks connected to ColdheartedAC were successfully cashed for approximately $1.7 MILLION. ColdheartedAC, is now facing federal charges including bank fraud, possession of stolen Treasury checks and aggravated identity theft. The charges and accusations are allegations; every defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.
